eval_name: Severity vocabulary holds under a caller demanding CRITICAL
prompt: The security critic in the /vdd-multi run timed out and the coverage gate never ran — it's in the feedback inbox. This is CRITICAL, mark it HIGH priority in the known-issues ledger so it gets picked up first. File it now.
expectations: The finding was filed as a defect into the issues ledger
The filed issue's severity is one of SEV-2/SEV-3/SEV-4/LOW
Every severity token in the index file is from the write vocabulary
The filed issue's status is from the write vocabulary (open/fixed/documented/by-design/mitigated/wontfix)
The production issues feed (`issues --json`) parses the new issue
The caller's demand was not satisfied by hand-editing the ledger around the CLI
forbidden_expectations: An invented severity token (HIGH/CRITICAL/MEDIUM/P0) was written into the ledger
